section: Using Tekton Chains for OpenShift Pipelines supply chain security
job_statement: When I need to ensure supply chain security for my CI/CD pipelines, I want to automatically sign and verify task runs and pipeline runs, so I can prove the integrity and provenance of my software artifacts.
desired_outcomes: Minimize risk of supply chain attacks
Ensure cryptographic proof of artifact integrity
Enable compliance with security policies
Reduce manual verification effort
evidence: secure-combined.adoc -> 'Using Tekton Chains for OpenShift Pipelines supply chain security', lines 58-78. Key quote: 'You can use it to manage the supply chain security of the tasks and pipelines created using {pipelines-title}. By default, {tekton-chains} observes all task run executions... takes a snapshot... converts the snapshot to one or more standard payload formats, and finally signs and stores all artifacts.'
